sources.prompt:
Japanese anime-style chibi mobile-game environment art, like the tile set of a cosy slice-of-life anime puzzle game. Drawn by hand by a professional 2D anime game background artist: flat cel colours with one crisp hard-edged shadow tone, thick dark-brown outline (#4A2A1A) with slight natural line-weight variation (thicker on outer silhouettes, thinner on inner details), one small flat white highlight per shiny surface, chunky rounded chibi shapes (buildings, trees, rocks and props squashed and rounded like cute toys), limited warm Japanese palette, light from the top-left. Few, deliberate details, every shape clearly readable at 64 pixels. Avoid the typical AI-art look: no airbrushed or soft gradient shading, no plastic or 3D-render sheen, no photographic texture, no texture noise, no random extra sparkles or particles, no melted or merged details, no blurry edges. No characters or people unless asked, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Outline weight matches a cartoon salmon-nigiri game icon.

Setting: the Hokkaido Crab Hut region of the map, snowy northern Hokkaido: log huts under thick snow, smoking chimneys, a frozen sea and red crabs hung up to dry. Region colours: banner #6FC3C9 to #3A8A98, land #E8F2F4.

Tile sheet: 2x2 grid of 4 equal 512x512 cells, one item per cell, no borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels, no numbers. Straight top-down view, flat, no perspective. Every item at the same scale with the same outline weight. Ground tiles fill their cell edge to edge, opaque, with no outline or border round the cell; the left edge matches the right edge and the top edge matches the bottom edge so each repeats seamlessly.

Land:
f1 (top-left) land_a: smooth fresh snow with pale blue shading in #E8F2F4.
f2 (top-right) land_b: the same ground about 12% lighter, details in other places, so it alternates with land_a.
f3 (bottom-left) land_c: land_a with a small snow drift and tiny footprints.
f4 (bottom-right) land_d: land_b with a small snow drift and tiny footprints.
Use case: stylized-concept. Output square 1024x1024 opaque PNG with four exact equal logical quadrants, no visible grid lines or gutters. Each ground cell has a uniform solid pale snow color, left column #E8F2F4, right column near-white #F3F8F9. A few very restrained hard-edged pale-blue curved snow marks inside top cells. Bottom cells each contain exactly one small low snow drift and a short trail of tiny paired boot footprints, positioned differently. Keep all marks at least 10% away from the quadrant boundaries; borders stay plain flat solid snow for seamless repetition. Ground only: no buildings, mountains, trees, rocks or scenery. No gradients, mottled texture, soft shading, noise or outlined square cells.
